hab: A refinery the size of a town
bio: A rhino calf with a stubby horn that carries a sack of cement everywhere, in case.
A concrete-horned rhino with a sugar-cane tail and a refinery on its back. Half the towers in the Hollow Earth are poured from it.
note: Started with a loan from an uncle. Paid it back in concrete.
The refinery runs on its own sugar.
